title: Seabraid: an engine-neutral runtime for same-layer mixed-vendor Mixture-of-Experts execution
description: Seabraid lets GPUs from different vendors (NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm) serve the experts of one Mixture-of-Experts model at the same layer (expert braiding, formally cross-vendor expert parallelism). Each card runs vendor-native kernels in its own process; the processes meet in shared memory once per layer. The runtime provides an engine-neutral C ABI and acknowledged live expert placement. Developed by Saltwater Research LLC. The runtime is Apache-2.0. The source NOTICE describes the public headers and integration patch terms. Alpha software: see the repository documentation for what is measured, what is verified by tests, and what has not been run.
